feishuKnowledge.title: Feishu knowledge sync
feishuKnowledge.superuserOnly: Only active system superusers can manage Feishu knowledge synchronization.
feishuKnowledge.warning: One-way import only. Feishu permissions are NOT mirrored. Imported documents are accessible according to the target Clouisle knowledge base's local team permissions. Review access before enabling sync.
feishuKnowledge.credentials: Uses the existing Feishu app credentials and tenant access token. Supports documents, sheets, Bitable, and supported file attachments, including document images and attachments. Mindnote has no public content API and is reported as unsupported. Grant API permissions and access to the source resources.
feishuKnowledge.loadingOptions: Loading Feishu Wiki spaces and target knowledge bases…
feishuKnowledge.loadFailed: Could not load sources. Refresh to retry.
feishuKnowledge.name: Source name
feishuKnowledge.noOptions: No Wiki spaces are visible to this app, or no target knowledge base is available. API scopes do not grant resource access: enable the app's bot capability, then ask a Wiki administrator to authorize it from a document's … → More → Add Application menu. Alternatively, add the bot to a group and grant that group Wiki membership/administration. Only app-visible Wiki spaces are listed, not My Document Library. Also ensure a target Clouisle knowledge base exists. Close and reopen this dialog after authorization.
feishuKnowledge.deleteConfirm: Delete source “{name}”? All documents imported by this source, their search indexes, media, and stored files will also be permanently deleted.

integrations.wechatDescription: Manage WeChat Agent chat and knowledge collection. Each user authorizes their own connection in personal settings.
integrations.wechatUnavailable: The WeChat integration has not been initialized. Check backend startup.
integrations.wechatFeaturesHint: Enable only the features you need. Personal WeChat credentials and connection purposes remain in each user's settings.

wechatFeatureDescriptions.agent_chat: Allow users to send personal WeChat messages to published Agents they can access.
wechatFeatureDescriptions.knowledge_collection: Allow users to collect personal WeChat messages into writable knowledge bases.

integrations.wechatRuntimeHint: Existing workers and Celery Beat poll and process enabled features automatically; no extra service or command is needed. Disabling a feature pauses its intake, execution, and delivery while preserving connections, history, and pending work. Operations already started may still complete.
integrations.feishuDirectorySyncDisabledHint: Turn on the Directory sync capability in Integration configuration to browse and import departments.

integrations.feishuNotificationDisabledHint: Turn on the Notifications capability in Integration configuration to send Feishu messages.
integrations.feishuDescription: Connect Feishu to sync directory members and Feishu Wiki content into knowledge bases, and configure sign-in and notifications.
integrations.feishuNotificationDescription: Allow Feishu direct messages for manual and automatic notifications.
integrations.feishuAppSecretDesc: The App Secret is encrypted on the server. Leave blank to keep the saved secret.
integrations.feishuDepartmentsDesc: The top-level company is included as the root department. Selecting a department also selects its descendants. Sync creates or updates corresponding teams and adds Feishu members to their department teams; departed or inactive Feishu users are not disabled.
integrations.feishuNoDepartments: No departments are available. Check the Feishu app's contact permissions and data scope.
integrations.feishuDepartmentsFailed: Failed to load Feishu departments. Check app credentials and contact permissions.
integrations.feishuScopeSaveFailed: Failed to save Feishu department scope.
integrations.feishuSyncFailed: Failed to sync Feishu directory. Check app credentials and contact permissions.
integrations.feishuSyncResult: Sync complete: {created} accounts created, {updated} updated, {skipped} skipped; {teams_created} teams created.
integrations.feishuConnectionCheckSuccess: Feishu connection and contact access are working.
integrations.feishuTestFailed: Failed to send the test message.
integrations.feishuNoTestRecipients: No active users have a linked Feishu account.
integrations.feishuTestRecipientUnavailable: Select an active user linked to Feishu.
integrations.feishuDirectorySyncDescription: Import and sync members from selected Feishu departments.
integrations.feishuLoginDescription: Let members sign in with their Feishu account.
integrations.feishuAgentChatDescription: Let people message the configured Feishu bot and reach published Agents they can access in private chats.
integrations.feishuAgentChatRequirementsIntro: Enable the bot capability in Feishu Open Platform and grant these application identity permissions:
integrations.feishuAgentChatReceivePermission: Receive private messages sent to the bot. Group-mention permissions cannot replace this permission.
integrations.feishuAgentChatMediaPermission: Sending generated images, videos and files requires resource upload permission. In Feishu Open Platform → Permissions, grant im:resource (read and upload images or files). For file uploads only, im:resource:upload is also supported. Without upload permission, text replies may work while artifact delivery fails.
integrations.feishuAgentChatPublishRequirements: Subscribe to im.message.receive_v1 (Receive messages) using the selected delivery mode. After adding permissions, publish a new app version and complete any required administrator approval; selecting permissions alone does not activate them. Once effective, send a new private message asking the Agent to generate a file to verify artifact delivery.
integrations.feishuAgentChatConnectionNotice: Connected confirms only the WebSocket connection, not message permissions or event subscription. This channel processes private text messages only; group messages are ignored.
integrations.feishuAgentChatDisabledHint: Turn on the Agent chat capability in Integration configuration to configure this channel.
integrations.feishuAgentChatUnavailable: Save the Feishu app credentials to configure Agent chat.
integrations.feishuAgentChatLongConnectionDesc: Uses the saved App ID and App Secret. No public callback URL, Verification Token, or Encrypt Key is required.
integrations.feishuAgentChatLongConnectionSetup: In Feishu Open Platform → Events & callbacks, select long connection delivery and subscribe to im.message.receive_v1. Save this mode to apply automatically.
integrations.feishuAgentChatLongConnectionProcess: An existing agent-queue worker manages the receiver automatically; no extra service or command is needed. Disabling Agent chat stops reception. Mode or credential changes rebuild the connection automatically. Keep the API, worker, and Celery Beat running.
integrations.feishuAgentChatVerificationTokenDesc: Copied from the Feishu app's event subscription page. Encrypted on the server; leave blank to keep the saved value.
integrations.feishuAgentChatEncryptKeyDesc: Copied from the Feishu app's event subscription page. Encrypted on the server; leave blank to keep the saved value.
integrations.feishuAgentChatSecretsMissing: Save both the Verification Token and the Encrypt Key before enabling agent chat.
integrations.feishuAgentChatCallbackUrlDesc: Register this URL in the Feishu app's event subscription settings and choose encrypted delivery.
integrations.feishuAgentChatPersonalSelection: Each user selects their replying Agent in Personal settings → Feishu. This page manages only the shared channel, not users' Agent selections.
integrations.feishuAgentChatSaveFailed: Failed to save the Feishu agent chat configuration.
integrations.feishuButtonTextDesc: Text shown on the Feishu login button. Leave empty to use the default.
integrations.callbackUrlDesc: Register this URL as the redirect URI of the sign-in provider. The provider rejects sign-in callbacks until it is allowlisted there.

siteSettings.ssrfAllowedTargetsDescription: Approve internal IPs, CIDR subnets, or internal domains accessible by custom HTTP tools, workflow HTTP nodes, and knowledge base URL fetching.
siteSettings.ssrfAllowedTargetsHint: Enter one target per line (supports single IP, CIDR mask, or wildcard domain *.domain). Cloud metadata and multicast addresses are permanently blocked. To access host services, use your host LAN IP or host.docker.internal rather than 127.0.0.1.
